captions.detailed: This 3D model is a replacement plastic foot designed for tubular chair legs. It features a wide, flat bottom base with a rounded outer rim to sit stably on the floor. A hollow cylindrical sleeve rises from this base to snugly hold the chair leg, finished with a chamfered top edge that facilitates easy insertion of the tube.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric chair leg foot in OpenSCAD. The model should allow customization of the foot height, bottom base diameter, outer sleeve diameter, inner sleeve diameter, and the bottom thickness to fit various sizes of metal furniture tubing.
captions.factory: The script constructs the foot using a union of two main assemblies. First, the rounded bottom rim is created by applying a rotate_extrude on a translated circle, merged with a flat cylinder base, and cleaned up using a difference operation with a cutting cube. Second, the vertical sleeve is generated by differencing a main cylinder with an inner cylinder for the cavity, and subtracting a tapered cylinder at the top (constructed with r1 and r2 parameters) to create the chamfered entry guide.
